reviews.summary: Reviewed the cumulative Change across Completeness, Correctness, Coherence and Cleanliness. Common installation, stage dependency routing, guidance reuse and goal-level task instructions are supported by committed implementation and inspected trial traces. All 397 tests run passed; committed-source regeneration matched seven tracked Pi skills and 28 references. One blocking validation coverage regression remains. HEAD stayed unchanged and the worktree remained clean.
findings: CRITICAL — Restore length validation coverage for common and its references. test/skills/skill-template-length-validation.test.ts:26–44 still enumerates getSkillTemplates(), while src/core/shared/skill-generation.ts:98–107 adds common only through getInstallableSkillTemplates(). Moving shared references into src/core/templates/workflows/common.ts:70–80 therefore removes xirang-common/SKILL.md and 13 references from the existing 200/500-line guard, including artifact, configuration, business-specification, Design Record, model-context and semantic-authoring guidance. Committed-source enumeration confirmed these omissions. The current files satisfy the limits, but an over-limit common skill or moved reference would survive the maintained guard. This leaves the generation constraint in .xirang/changes/shared-xirang-skill/elements/skill-generation.md:38 without corresponding regression protection. Update the existing guard to enumerate the installable artifact set, preserving the six-stage registry. Search evidence: rg -n 'getInstallableSkillTemplates|MAX_SKILL_LINES|MAX_REFERENCE_LINES|MAX.*REFERENCE.*LINE|MAX.*SKILL.*LINE' test found no getInstallableSkillTemplates consumer and located the limits only in the stage-only guard.

reviews.summary: Independently reviewed the complete cumulative Change from 5dd53d1ed3b78f9f6a441f338ecc24922080f272 across Completeness, Correctness, Coherence and Cleanliness, including all five Delta units and the length-guard Required Correction. Common is explicitly included in installation and managed ownership without expanding the stage registry (src/core/shared/skill-generation.ts:34-39,98-107; src/core/templates/sync-engine.ts:116-142); installation/update and user-file preservation have executable coverage (test/core/workflow-installation.test.ts:72-97). Stage selection, direct-entry continuation, independent-Agent loading, current-context reuse and conditional references are coherently delivered (src/core/templates/workflows/common.ts:26-80; src/core/templates/fragments/guidance-loading.ts:3-12). Retained trial events independently corroborate both entry orders, Explore-to-Propose reuse, readiness blocking, guidance-update reload and lost-context recovery; their procedure and bounded claims are committed in .xirang/changes/shared-xirang-skill/verification.json:7-30. Goal-level task guidance agrees with Apply's dynamic test selection and preserves Review/Opt/Seal gates (src/core/templates/workflows/propose.ts:68-71,87-103,125; src/core/templates/workflows/apply-change.ts:232-261). The corrected guard enumerates installable common and every attached reference under the existing limits (test/skills/skill-template-length-validation.test.ts:26-44,87-94). Independent typecheck and 279 tests in 22 relevant files passed; cumulative diff whitespace check passed. Windows CI run 42987224888 was independently confirmed successful for implementation commit 1827ec2a02eda4f03e328073c4e4654771c614c0. HEAD and worktree status stayed unchanged throughout assessment; the existing untracked Quality file was excluded. Residual limits: actual Agent trials cover Pi and one model with incomplete project fixtures, and do not establish general token, cost or latency savings. No blocking findings.
